mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the channels was most worthwhile because it showed how local electrical changes pass a message along the cell, rather than one ion travelling the whole way.

leastWorthwhile.text: Developing the two cell types felt somewhat repetitive: both followed the same population-and-messenger pattern.

surprise.text: I was surprised that no single ion needs to travel the full length of the nerve fibre for a message to move along it.

arbitrary.text: The named messenger pairings were clear from the pictures and goals, but I followed them without understanding exactly how the messengers cause the cells to develop.

continue.text: I would choose to continue because seeing the channels and insulating cells fitted together made me curious about what nerve messages do next.
